title: DNA Purification from Agarose Gels with GenElute Gel Extraction Kit
author: Ana Belem García González

steps.title: Run agarose gel electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Perform agarose gel electrophoresis of the DNA sample, loading the maximum amount of DNA per well; use multiple wells if necessary.

steps.title: Excise band of interest
steps.instruction: Cut out the desired DNA band from the gel, removing excess agarose.

steps.title: Weigh gel slice
steps.instruction: Place the excised gel piece into a pre‑weighed tube and record its weight.

steps.title: Dissolve gel in solubilization solution
steps.instruction: Add 3 volumes of Gel Solubilization Solution (e.g., 300 µL per 100 mg gel). Incubate at 50–60 °C for 10 min or until the gel is completely dissolved, vortexing every 2–3 min.

steps.title: Prepare binding column
steps.instruction: Insert a GenElute Binding Column G into a 2 mL collection tube. Add 500 µL Column Preparation Solution. Centrifuge 1 min at 12,000–16,000 × g. Discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Verify solution color
steps.instruction: After gel dissolution, ensure the solution is yellow. If it is red, add 10 µL 3 M sodium acetate (pH 5.2) and mix; repeat until the solution turns yellow.

steps.title: Add isopropanol
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of 100 % isopropanol to the dissolved gel solution and mix until homogeneous.

steps.title: Bind DNA to column
steps.instruction: Load the isopropanol‑treated sample onto the prepared binding column (color change to red is normal). If the volume exceeds 700 µL, load in ≤700 µL aliquots. After each load, centrifuge 1 min at 12,000–16,000 × g and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Wash column
steps.instruction: Add 700 µL Wash Solution to the column, centrifuge 1 min at 12,000–16,000 × g, and discard the flow‑through. Re‑place the column in the collection tube and centrifuge another 1 min to remove residual ethanol.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the column to a clean sterile tube. Add 50 µL Elution Solution to the membrane centre, incubate 1 min, then centrifuge 1 min at 12,000–16,000 × g. For plasmid DNA or fragments >3 kb, pre‑heat the Elution Solution to 65 °C before use.
